prompt.zh: 创作一张写实摄影风格的方形图像：参考图1中的同一只虎斑猫坐在画面左侧，参考图2中的同一只金毛犬坐在画面右侧，它们并肩位于湖边的木质码头上，在蓝调时刻一起看向镜头。准确保留两只动物各自的脸部特征、毛色、斑纹、耳形和身体比例；统一环境光、接触阴影与景深。画面中必须恰好只有一只猫和一只狗，不得融合两者特征，不得增加其他动物。
prompt.en: Create a square photorealistic image in which the same tabby cat from reference 1 sits on the left and the same golden retriever from reference 2 sits on the right, side by side on a wooden lakeside pier at blue hour, both looking toward the camera. Faithfully preserve each animal's facial features, coat color, markings, ear shape and body proportions; use coherent environmental lighting, contact shadows and depth of field. Show exactly one cat and one dog, do not blend their traits, and add no other animals.
